name: PAN-OS DNS Malware or New Domain Threat
description: Detects PAN-OS THREAT telemetry classified as dns-malware or dns-new-domain. Scoped to DNS threat categories not covered by the blocked non-URL rule; validate alert volume and false-positive rate.
note: Created from a bounded 24-hour PAN-OS baseline; excludes no events and does not modify firewall policy.
author: SOC Manager
false_positives: Legitimate newly observed domains may match dns-new-domain; triage before suppression.
query: event.dataset:"panw.panos" and panw.panos.type:"THREAT" and panw.panos.threat_category:("dns-malware" or "dns-new-domain") and event.action:"spyware_detected"
